(Vādi)devasūri
Jain. Śvet. teacher of Bṛhadgaccha; born 1143 A. D.; son of Vīranāga an. Jinadevi; teacher of Ratnaprabhasūri (a. of C. on Upadeśamālā), Maheśvarasūri (a. of C. on Āvaśyakasvarūpa, BORI. D. XVIII. i. 171) an. pupil of Municandrasūri (a. of C. on Lalitavistara, BORI. D. XVII. iii. 845); [Page125-b] defeated Digambara Kumudacandra a. the court of King Jayasim3ha of Anhilwad in Gujarat in 1121 A. D. (on which incident Yaśaścandra wrote Mudritakumudacandraprakaraṇa, BORI. D. XIV. 186); had a dispute with Guṇacandra on behalf of King Arṇorāja. See ZDMG. 75 (1921) 61-62. Mentioned by Vijayavimalagaṇi in his C. on Gacchācāra (verse no. 24). See BORI. D. XVII. i. 382; also K. C. Jain, Jainism in Rajasthan p. 206.
